build_frontend: build the AcuteEvalBuilder frontend by running npm install and webpack dev build
rebuild_frontend: rebuild the AcuteEvalBuilder frontend by cleaning the build directory and running npm install then webpack
build_in_directory: build the AcuteEvalBuilder frontend and copy bundle.js and index.html into a target server directory
validate_task_dir: validate that an AcuteEvalBuilder task directory is valid by calling task_dir_is_valid
copy_static_assets: copy the built bundle.js and index.html static assets from the frontend build directory to a target path
